questions.question_english: Rule 19 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 deals with the vindication of acts and character of Government servants. Which of the following statements is true regarding this rule?
options_english: A Government servant can freely file a defamation suit against anyone criticizing their official acts without seeking prior departmental permission.
Previous sanction of the Government is required for recourse to courts or press for vindication of official acts.

Government servants are strictly prohibited from taking any legal action to vindicate their private character under all circumstances.
questions.explanation_english: Previous sanction of the Government is required for recourse to courts or press for vindication of official acts. Rule 19 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 mandates that no public servant shall, except with previous government sanction, have recourse to courts or the press for vindicating any official act subjected to adverse criticism. Public servants may, however, vindicate private character without prior sanction by submitting a report.

questions.question_english: Under Rule 15 (Private trade or employment), a Government servant must obtain previous sanction of the Government to do which of the following?
options_english: Undertake honorary work of a social or charitable nature
Engage directly or indirectly in any trade or business
Undertake occasional work of a literary, artistic, or scientific character
Participate in sports activities as an amateur
questions.explanation_english: Rule 15 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 requires previous government sanction for engaging directly or indirectly in any trade, commercial business, or secondary gainful employment. key_facts: Rule 15 mandates prior government sanction for trade or business.
Exemptions exist for honorary and non-interfering activities.
Printed answer key: (b) Engage directly or indirectly in any trade or business

questions.question_english: Under Rule 15, a Government servant is prohibited from undertaking any other employment. Does this prohibition extend to running a private tuition centre outside office hours?
options_english: No, teaching is considered an honorable noble profession and is fully exempted from all conduct restrictions.
Yes, running a coaching centre requires prior sanction and is generally not permitted.
No, provided the private tuition centre does not enroll any students currently studying in the Government servant’s own school.
Yes, but obtaining prior permission becomes mandatory only if the annual remuneration from private tuition exceeds Rs. 50,000.
questions.explanation_english: Yes, running a coaching centre requires prior sanction and is generally not permitted. Under Rule 15 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, running a commercial coaching centre or private tuition business constitutes engaging in trade or commercial activities, which is prohibited for government servants without prior approval. This rule is in place to prevent conflicts of interest and ensure that government employees remain focused on their official duties.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। हाँ, कोचिंग केंद्र चलाने के लिए पूर्व स्वीकृति आवश्यक है और आमतौर पर इसकी अनुमति नहीं है। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (आचार) नियम, 1964 के नियम 15 के तहत, एक व्यावसायिक कोचिंग केंद्र या निजी ट्यूशन व्यवसाय चलाना व्यापार या वाणिज्यिक गतिविधियों में संलग्न होना है, जो सरकारी कर्मचारियों के लिए पूर्व अनुमोदन के बिना प्रतिबंधित है। यह नियम हितों के टकराव को रोकने और यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए है कि सरकारी कर्मचारी अपने आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करें।
key_facts: Rule 15 prohibits government servants from undertaking any other employment without prior approval.
Running a coaching centre is considered engaging in trade, which is not allowed.
Printed answer key: (B) Yes, running a coaching centre requires prior sanction and is generally not permitted.

questions.question_english: According to Rule 18, which of the following is considered 'movable property'?
options_english: Agricultural land utilized for commercial farming and crop production
A residential house, apartment, or vacant housing plot in an urban area
Jewellery, insurance policies, and shares
Commercial real estate properties including office complexes and retail shops
questions.explanation_english: Rule 18 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 defines movable property to include jewellery, insurance policies, shares, securities, debentures, loans, motor vehicles, electronic items, and agricultural equipment. Immovable properties like land, residential flats, housing plots, and commercial complexes are classified separately under real property regulations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। नियम 18 के अनुसार, चल संपत्ति में गहने, बीमा पॉलिसियाँ, शेयर, प्रतिभूतियाँ, डिबेंचर, ऋण, मोटर वाहन, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सामान और कृषि उपकरण शामिल हैं। अचल संपत्तियों जैसे भूमि, आवासीय फ्लैट, आवासीय भूखंड और व्यावसायिक परिसर को अचल संपत्ति विनियमों के तहत अलग से वर्गीकृत किया गया है।
key_facts: Rule 18 defines movable property.
Includes items like jewellery and shares.
Immovable properties are classified separately.
Printed answer key: (C) Jewellery, insurance policies, and shares

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding evidence before Committees (Rule 10 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964):
I. A Government servant must obtain prior sanction before giving evidence in connection with any inquiry conducted by a private individual or body.
II. No prior sanction is required to give evidence before an authority appointed by the Government, Parliament, or a State Legislature.
III. While giving evidence before a Government-appointed committee, the Government servant is free to criticize the policy of the Central Government.
IV. No prior sanction is needed for giving evidence in any judicial inquiry.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and III only
I, II and IV only
II, III and IV only
I, III and IV only
questions.explanation_english: Rule 10 requires prior administrative sanction before giving evidence in private inquiries, while exempting evidence presented before government, parliamentary, or judicial bodies. However, while giving evidence before government-appointed committees, public servants are strictly prohibited from criticizing government policies, making statement III incorrect while statements I, II, and IV are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नियम 10 के अनुसार, निजी जांचों में साक्ष्य देने से पहले पूर्व प्रशासनिक अनुमति आवश्यक है, जबकि सरकारी, संसदीय, या न्यायिक निकायों के समक्ष प्रस्तुत साक्ष्य को छूट दी गई है। हालांकि, सरकारी नियुक्त समितियों के समक्ष साक्ष्य देते समय, सरकारी कर्मचारियों को सरकारी नीतियों की आलोचना करने से सख्ती से रोका गया है, जिससे बयान III गलत हो जाता है जबकि बयान I, II, और IV सही हैं।
key_facts: Rule 10 mandates prior sanction for private inquiries.
No sanction needed for government or judicial inquiries.
Public servants cannot criticize government policies in committee evidence.
Printed answer key: (B) I, II and IV only

questions.question_english: Which of the following rules restricts a Government servant from acting as an arbitrator in any dispute between private parties?
options_english: Rule 10 (Evidence before Committee)
Rule 15 (Private trade or employment)
Rule 16 (Investments)
Rule 19 (Vindication of acts)
questions.explanation_english: The statutory rule prescribes option (B). Rule 15 of the CCS Conduct Rules 1964 explicitly prohibits government servants from engaging in private trade or employment, which includes acting as an arbitrator in disputes between private parties. This rule is in place to prevent conflicts of interest and ensure that government employees remain impartial in their official duties.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नियम 15, CCS आचार नियम 1964 के तहत सरकारी कर्मचारियों को निजी व्यापार या रोजगार में संलग्न होने से स्पष्ट रूप से रोकता है, जिसमें निजी पक्षों के बीच विवादों में मध्यस्थ के रूप में कार्य करना शामिल है। यह नियम हितों के टकराव को रोकने और यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए है कि सरकारी कर्मचारी अपने आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों में निष्पक्ष रहें।
key_facts: नियम 15: निजी व्यापार या रोजगार में संलग्नता पर प्रतिबंध
हितों के टकराव को रोकने के लिए नियम
Printed answer key: (B) Rule 15 (Private trade or employment)

questions.question_english: Under the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964, which of the following categories of employees is explicitly exempted from the application of these rules?
options_english: Civilian employees in Defence Services
Government servants holding Group C posts
Government servants working in the Union Territories
Members of the All India Services
questions.explanation_english: Members of the All India Services are explicitly exempted from the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 because they are governed by their own specific rules, namely the All India Services (Conduct) Rules, 1968. Civilian defence employees, Group C staff, and Union Territory employees remain fully subject to the Central Civil Services rules.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। अखिल भारतीय सेवाओं के सदस्य केंद्रीय सिविल सेवाएँ (आचार) नियम, 1964 के अनुप्रयोग से स्पष्ट रूप से छूट प्राप्त करते हैं क्योंकि वे अपने विशेष नियमों, अर्थात् अखिल भारतीय सेवाएँ (आचार) नियम, 1968 द्वारा शासित होते हैं। नागरिक रक्षा कर्मचारी, समूह C के कर्मचारी और संघीय क्षेत्र के कर्मचारी केंद्रीय सिविल सेवाओं के नियमों के अधीन रहते हैं।
key_facts: Members of All India Services are exempt from CCS (Conduct) Rules.
Governed by All India Services (Conduct) Rules, 1968.
Civilian defence employees are subject to CCS rules.
Printed answer key: (D) Members of the All India Services

questions.question_english: Rule 3(1)(xvi) states that a Government servant shall not commit any act of sexual harassment of any woman at her workplace. This aligns with the statutory obligations under which of the following Acts?
options_english: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 and associated judicial guidelines
Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 and related statutory public welfare enactments
Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013
Indecent Representation of Women (Prohibition) Act, 1986 and connected statutory provisions
questions.explanation_english: Rule 3(1)(xvi) and Rule 3C of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 align directly with statutory provisions mandated under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. This statutory alignment ensures comprehensive institutional protection and legal redress mechanisms across all government work environments.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। नियम 3(1)(xvi) और केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (आचरण) नियम, 1964 का नियम 3C महिलाओं के कार्यस्थल पर यौन उत्पीड़न रोकथाम अधिनियम, 2013 के तहत निर्धारित वैधानिक प्रावधानों के साथ सीधे संबंधित है। यह वैधानिक संरेखण सभी सरकारी कार्य वातावरण में व्यापक संस्थागत सुरक्षा और कानूनी निवारण तंत्र सुनिश्चित करता है।
key_facts: Rule 3(1)(xvi) prohibits sexual harassment at the workplace.
Aligned with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013.
Ensures legal protection for women in government services.
Printed answer key: (c) Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace
